author: /root/scale_engineering

objective.scope: One fresh complete measurement-coverage study under the unchanged original scale protocol; not release, G8, quality, causal speedup, or automatic task closure.
objective.explanation: A separate auxiliary 1k/10k/100k engineering run is not a prerequisite in the original task/scale contract. The five original formal repetition-zero shards are the admission gate and count once in N30.

measured_source.manifest_scope: Original p7_build_identity.source_snapshot Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock + complete crates tracked-input map; exact source-before and source-after must match.
measured_source.loaded_replayer_rule: Load unchanged scripts/p8_scale_matrix.py and scripts/p7_build_identity.py from a real clean Git checkout of this exact commit. Capacity observer is separately checked against its exact committed source. Never relabel another source or a PR merge checkout as this commit.

original_ci.source_equivalence_scope: Independent review verified all 12 non-artifact root entries equal the registered 275e head. The original CI checkout was the historical PR merge above, not literal 275e and not a later merge.
original_ci.counting_boundary: Rust count is executions, not unique methods. Original ignored tests remain explicitly ignored and are not claimed executed.

surface_window_controls.fixture_cost_scope: 90 bounded SQL equivalence cases (54 surface + 36 dependency); no large-scale speedup inference.

requirements: P8-005 fixed-seed release 1k/5k/10k/50k/100k; report chunks/edges/vectors; no file-count-only or mismatched-workload ratios; preserve regressions and not_run/blocked.
P8-006 no-op/body/API/config/batch/over-budget closure; attributable time; complete full parity after closure; explicit incomplete status; original dependencies remain.

excerpts.first_slices: 工作流先构建并封存一次 release 可执行文件，再对五个规范规模各执行 `shard-index=0`。这些是原注册总体中真实的 `repetition=0`。
excerpts.complete_population: 五个首片全部成功后，`measure` 才执行同一固定源码与二进制的 shard 1–29。两段分别包含 5 片与 145 片，交集为空；合计仍为五规模各 30 个全局重复，全部 150 片、1500 个样本。
excerpts.failure_gate: 首片任一失败时，剩余 145 片不启动；失败片的原始记录照常上传。
excerpts.source_freeze: 每次完整执行应先固定最终的 **完整 Git SHA**，再让 build、首片、余下片和 aggregate 全部检出该 SHA。

requirements: Failures, infrastructure invalidity and budget stops remain distinct with original partial evidence.
All registered samples retained, no best-of or unsupported stable tail/causal claim.

activation.registration_publication_rule: Root publishes this immutable plan plus independent review on an evidence-only branch before the trigger. Do not move, add files to, or repin the measured 275e branch.
activation.label: p8-scale-run

prior_inventory_observation.source: root read-only native gh complete original-workflow inventory filtered by head275e

fresh_pretrigger_requirements: Root and a non-author accept the published exact plan.
Read actual PR173 head and ensure it remains 275e, open, and label p8-scale-run absent.
Read all pages of existing p8-scale.yml runs with this exact head; require zero before this one new study is triggered.
Record registration commit/tree, plan bytes/SHA and independent review; record immediate pre-trigger UTC and the request intent in a separate receipt.
activation.response_ambiguity_rule: If the response is unclear, do not repeat, remove/re-add the label, dispatch, rerun or create a replacement run. Read PR events and complete workflow-run pages to determine whether the one intended event produced a unique eligible run; otherwise remain blocked with the ambiguity preserved.
activation.actual_binding_rule: After the trigger, append a separate immutable receipt binding the single actual run to registration, original workflow path/ID, PR173, head/branch, event, attempt1 and created_at no earlier than the recorded trigger cutoff. Record all pages, actual IDs and the event relation. Never invent IDs. Reject ambiguous/multiple candidates; no automatic selection or extra trigger.
activation.checkout_rule: For the labeled PR event, every original workflow checkout uses github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha. Require actual product/source receipts to report 275e; a merge GITHUB_SHA is not a substitute.

execution.runner_scope: fresh GitHub-hosted VM per job; no paid or self-hosted runner
execution.features: default executable features only, original Cargo artifact verifier accepts [] or ['default']

immutable_build.proof: Original Cargo stdout/stderr, unique artifact line with exact producer manifest/src/executable, original copy-source path/bytes/SHA, preserved executable bytes, release profile, toolchain and source/driver before-after records. These future hashes are filled only by the original build and bound identically in all 150 shard receipts.

execution.temporal_scope: No wall-clock success estimate is registered. Native per-shard deadline is 300 minutes, supervisor 302 minutes, job limit 350 minutes, with original build/queue/upload overhead. Hosted runner communication loss is infrastructure failure unless original evidence proves a more specific cause.

population.full_population_rule: All 45 scale-stage groups and five independent fanout groups retain exact repetition IDs 0..29. There are not ten groups at each scale. No duplicate/missing IDs, no borrowed old samples, no pooled replacement, no repetition-zero exclusion or remeasurement.

fixed_capacity_contract.disk_requirement_scope: Preregistered capacity estimate, not an observed peak or proof of sufficiency.
fixed_capacity_contract.preparation: Only the existing observer on this disposable GitHub-hosted Ubuntu24 VM, exact source and repository checks, explicit original opt-in, and only fixed unused /usr/local/lib/android and /usr/share/dotnet if required. Original same-privilege process-group deadline, stdout/stderr and before/after receipts remain. No current/shared host cleanup, unrelated path deletion, reduced threshold, additional storage or paid allocation.
fixed_capacity_contract.insufficient_capacity: Original explicit nonzero/not_run or failed preparation with available original evidence; do not launch the native workload, lower the threshold or fabricate a pass.

original_correctness_and_statistics.parity: Unchanged complete typed canonical Value comparison for all fifteen tables, all original row duplicates/counts and original integrity/FK gates. No sampling, digest-only equality, reduced oracle frequency, omitted data or limits.
original_correctness_and_statistics.stage_contract: Every cold and mutation checkpoint retains its independent full control. Closure must complete under original budgets before full parity can certify it. Actual original over-budget fanout evidence is mandatory in aggregate; unfinished closure remains explicitly incomplete.
original_correctness_and_statistics.attribution: Keep every original build/phase/SQL work report, original input/file/chunk/edge/vector workload counts, full_staging and timing conservation fields. Nested timings are not double-counted.
original_correctness_and_statistics.all_failures: Retain every registered original failed/not_run/incomplete/timeout/infrastructure outcome and partial raw, including missing artifacts if a runner dies. Failed or absent shards never count as successful observations, are never removed from the population and cannot be repaired with another run.
original_correctness_and_statistics.heterogeneous_hosts: Preserve each original host/CPU/kernel/core/parallelism/environment identity and all per-sample environment mappings. Replayer computes within-environment strata; pooled latency statistics are explicitly not computed. No fastest-host selection, same-host causal claim or stable p95/p99 claim.
original_correctness_and_statistics.replayer: Exact original validate_build -> validate_shard -> inspect_raw -> combine/aggregate at source275e, all 150 original raw inputs and all original source/binary/driver/profile/config/seed/environment checks; summaries never replace replay.

evidence_and_reception.remote_matrix_rule: When published, retain and compare the original matrix result and job conclusion, including failure. Strict unchanged original aggregate must pass on complete raw before claiming complete measurement coverage. A missing/failed remote aggregate caused by independent infrastructure cannot be called Actions success; report it separately, without silently promoting remote job greenness into a replacement for raw replay.
reception_steps: Read all workflow/job/artifact API pages and actual total_count; pin run/head/event/attempt and record missing/extra/expired artifacts.

Download original ZIPs by actual IDs; verify registered API bytes/digest, full ZIP bytes, every central-directory member CRC/SHA, safe paths and complete bidirectional inventories; preserve all original files and required executable copies.

Use exact275e committed replay code and original single build; verify all source-before/after1089 inputs and driver/binary/copy provenance, original plans, raw line termination/duplicate-key checks, all stages and all150 distinct shard IDs.
Independently verify all150 original capacity receipts and their observer source/context/threshold/protected-cleanup outcomes; the native aggregate does not consume these separate capacity artifacts.

Replay unchanged full aggregate with repetitions30/shard_count30/capacity profile; require 50 groups each exactN30, total1500, complete parity and actual over-budget closure; preserve original host strata.

Seal final source/executable/original ZIP hashes again and preserve success, failure, partial and not_run reports. If local resource constraints prevent complete reception, use an independently reviewed offline receiver; never lower original predicates or rerun product measurement.
evidence_and_reception.source_identity_of_registration: Registration/review commits and future offline-receiver commits are not the measured product source.
evidence_and_reception.public_output: No tokens, signed storage URLs, private download URIs or secret-bearing job-log excerpts in publication. Keep safe API identities and exact original hashes; disclose any separately obtained original logs required for replay.

prior_studies_retained.failure_scope: 100k first slice hosted runner lost communication; original native terminal raw missing. CPU/memory/network/runner termination are possible annotation causes only, not established OOM/deadline.

changes_authorized_by_plan: Registration and later one existing-workflow trigger only, after root and independent approval; no product/workflow/guard/ledger/budget mutation. This author creates only an unreferenced plan blob; root owns tree/ref/trigger.
acceptance_status: not_run; this document and prior CI/controls do not certify any of the new150 measurements
